title: Among users who have earned the 'Organizer' badge and are located in India,
question: Among users who have earned the 'Organizer' badge and are located in India, find the one whose posts received the highest total view count. Return their display name and the total view count.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055", SUM(T3."XCL_030") AS total_view_count
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T1."XCL_052" = T3."XCL_033"
WHERE T2."XCL_003" = 'Organizer'
  AND T1."XCL_058" = 'India'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052"
ORDER BY total_view_count DESC
LIMIT 1
